in_marathi.name: Drayansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Drayansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Drayansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'drayati' which means 'to bestow grace'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is known for his grace and protection. Drayansh is believed to bring good fortune and blessings to the child.
